summary: Tested the soft-deleted org lockout fix against the live Convex deployment fearless-ostrich-878 using org_test_1. Backend: 18 of 21 pytest cases passed (test_soft_deleted_org_lockout.py). A PENDING payment request was created first, then the org was soft-deleted. While deleted: GET /auth/me returns org.status DELETED. /products, /customers, /sales and /stats/overview return 400 with the deleted message and +963947744162. GET /subscription and /subscription/quote are blocked. POST /upgrade-requests and resubmitting a receipt are blocked with 'الحساب موقوف … +963947744162'. Developer actions that should fail all failed with 'المؤسسة محذوفة', and the org stayed DELETED after each one: assign-plan, PATCH status ACTIVE, the reactivate/unfreeze/extend/suspend/freeze sub-actions, and approving the pending request (which was not approved). The 3 failures: GET /plans, /payment-methods and /upgrade-requests still return 200 for the deleted org's owner. These are read-only and nothing gets re-activated. Frontend at 390x844: the owner of the deleted org lands on /blocked. It shows the deleted message, the org name, blocked-support-number '+963947744162' and blocked-whatsapp-button (52px tall). blocked-upgrade-button is absent (count 0), the refresh button keeps the screen blocked, and there were 0 page errors. The direct deep link /upgrade still opens the plans page and payment sheet. Submitting there returns HTTP 400, and the red toast shows the full deleted message with +963947744162, so the backend blocks it. Finally org_test_1 was restored. It is ACTIVE, LICENSE Pro, with the same expires_at 2027-11-03. 6 products load, /subscription returns 200, /owner/products renders, and the pending test request was cancelled.

minor.issue: billing.plansList, methodsList, requestsList and settingsGet only call getUser (billing.ts:32/55/197/332), not require(...,{billing:true}). The owner of a DELETED org still gets 200 from all four. They are read-only and nothing is re-activated, but the requirement says all org operations stop. Add assertNotDeleted for non-developer users.

expiryReminderPlan (billing.ts:673) skips SUSPENDED orgs but not DELETED ones. The owner of a deleted LICENSE org will still get an SMS and in-app message saying 'جدّد اشتراكك' with the /renew link, which contradicts the deleted/suspended message. Add `|| o.status === 'DELETED'` to the guard. Other crons are fine because they are gated by isPro, which requires status ACTIVE.
Still present from the previous iteration: restore always sets status ACTIVE (devAdmin.ts:88), so a status of SUSPENDED/FROZEN from before the delete is lost.

This is a code review only; the endpoint was not run, because it would wipe the Pro plan of org_test_1. On a DELETED org it still downgrades the plan to FREE. It keeps the DELETED status, so it does not re-activate the org, but there is no DELETED guard, which is inconsistent with the other dev subscription mutations.
In the developer subscriptions list, the state mapping (subscription.ts:98) has no DELETED branch, so a deleted org shows as ACTIVE/EXPIRED/FREE.

ui_bugs.issue: _layout.tsx:74 always allows seg 'upgrade' for OWNER. A deleted org's owner can deep-link to /upgrade, see the plans, fill in the whole payment sheet and upload a receipt, and only gets the error toast on submit. Redirect DELETED orgs to /blocked, or show the deleted banner on /upgrade and hide choose-plan.

action_items: Guard billing.plansList/methodsList/requestsList/settingsGet with assertNotDeleted(org, DELETED_OWNER_MSG) for non-DEVELOPER users, or switch them to require(..., {billing:true}).
billing.ts expiryReminderPlan: skip orgs with status DELETED so deleted orgs get no renew SMS or notification.
_layout.tsx: do not allow /upgrade when user.org.status === 'DELETED'; redirect to /blocked.
Optional: add a DELETED guard to devAdmin.cancelSubscription, add a DELETED state to devSubscriptions, and save/restore prev_status in softDeleteOrg.
Optional DRY: SUPPORT_WHATSAPP is hard-coded both in blocked.tsx:9 and in convex/lib.ts:152.
critical_code_review_comments: lib.require now runs assertNotDeleted for both the billing and non-billing paths for non-developers. That is correct and covers all org mutations and queries that go through require.
assertNotDeleted is in place in devReview approve, devAssignPlan, devSubAction (every action) and devPatchOrg (every patch, including tier/limits). All verified live.
statusFor maps DELETED_OWNER_MSG to 400 and DELETED_DEV_MSG to 403, because the latter contains 'اشتراك'. Both are acceptable.

success_rate.backend: 86% (18/21; the 3 failures are read-only billing GETs that are not blocked)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for the blocked screen requirements; /upgrade deep link only blocked at submit

seed_data_creation: One PENDING upgrade request (TESTREF-*) was created for org_test_1 and cancelled at teardown. org_test_1 was soft-deleted twice and restored to ACTIVE each time (verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_soft_deleted_org_lockout.py soft-deletes org_test_1 and ALWAYS restores it in the module fixture teardown. Do not run cancel-subscription on org_test_1, because it wipes the Pro plan. The submit-upgrade-button in the payment sheet needs page.click(force=True), and the method option and pick-image need dispatch_event('click'). The toast shows briefly, so poll for its text.
rca_of_issue: Fix verified: re-activation through billing is now blocked by assertNotDeleted in all developer re-activation paths, and in lib.require for owners.
